findings.title: Grafana rules cannot be deleted from the list view
findings.body: The menu now derives delete permission from `promRule` when the list view has no `rulerRule`, but this item is still gated on `rulerRule` being present. `GrafanaRuleListItem` supplies only `promRule`, so even users with delete permission never see Delete for Grafana rules in the list view. Gate the item on an available rule identifier and pass that identifier to the delete handler instead.

findings.title: Silence action does not open its drawer for list-view rules
findings.body: The list view passes the rule as `promRule` and leaves `rule` undefined. Although `AlertRuleMenu` can now determine silence ability from the Prometheus DTO and invokes `handleSilence`, the drawer is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. That condition is false for list-view rules, so clicking Silence closes the menu without opening the drawer. Render the drawer for Grafana alerting `promRule` too, using a compatible drawer input or an equivalent Prometheus-rule path.

findings.title: Filtered Grafana items omit their React key
findings.body: The filtered-results loop computes a unique `key` for every rule, but the Grafana branch does not pass it to `GrafanaRuleListItem`, unlike the other branches. React therefore sees unkeyed list children when filtered Grafana rules are rendered, which can reuse component state for the wrong rule as results change and produces missing-key warnings. Pass `key={key}` to this component.
